# RenderTexture

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Graphics` · class

```csharp
public sealed class RenderTexture : Texture
```

Types: [`Texture`](Texture.md)

A texture you can draw into with [`GraphicsService.UseRenderTarget`](GraphicsService.md#userendertarget), then draw like any other texture. Its pixels can be read back with `ReadPixelsAsync`.
